items.title: American Express (AXP) Adds Business Savings And Payroll Tools
items.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) has launched American Express Business Savings Accounts and a new integrated Business Banking platform for SMBs. The company is adding a payroll solution that uses AI-powered tools to help automate tasks for business customers. These services extend American Express beyond cards into broader small and medium-sized business financial services and digital banking. items.title: How Has Visa's Growth Story Changed?
items.summary: Visa's management tells its growth story differently than it did two years ago. That matters for your money. The shares cost 31 times a year of earnings, against 22.4 times for the S&P 500. A price that high assumes the growth keeps coming. One label that used to feature in Visa's results has faded. Which part of the business did Visa's management use to highlight in its quarterly results.

items.title: Exclusivity Lite? Everyday Brands Help Sell Near-Premium Credit Cards
items.summary: With annual fees for luxury credit cards reaching stratospheric heights, issuers are pursuing the next level down in affluence with more modestly priced alternatives.  “What has emerged is what I would call the upper-middle-class option,” principal consumer finance analyst Ted Rossman tells The Wall Street Journal’s Ben Glickman and Jasmine Li.  American Express  hiked the fee on its Platinum card by $200 last year to $895, but its Gold card costs only $325.
